title: rosa × schleicheri var. semirepens
intro: Rosa × schleicheri var. semirepens, commonly known as the climbing rose or Rosa semirepens, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This perennial climbing shrub is known for its fragrant flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Rosa × schleicheri var. semirepens include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and protect against cardiovascular disease and certain types of cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
